studyMetadata.title: Webcam eye-tracker pilot
studyMetadata.description: ~5 min. Records the webcam video with a timestamped dot and frame log (no tracker runs live): 15 calibration dots, 16 check dots, 20 s smooth pursuit, 5x5 map, re-positioning, the study's 3-dot per-trial check, 16 check dots, 15 recalibration dots, 16 final check dots. Invited participants only.
